REPLACEMENT OF OIL SEAL

1. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE EXTENSION HOUSING OIL
SEAL.

(a) Remove the dust deflector.

(b) Using a screwdriver, pry out the oil seal.

RM0176

(c) Using SST, drive in a new oil seal.
SST 09325-40010

(d) Install the dust deflector.

SST
